title: anymissing
summary: Return true when an input contains at least one missing value.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered before inspection.

description: `anymissing(A)` is the scalar predicate companion to `ismissing`; it is true when any entry of `A` is missing.
behaviors: Numeric `NaN`, missing strings, missing cells, structs with missing fields, and tables with any missing variable entry all return true.
Nonmissing numeric, logical, integer, and string values return false.
